dualPrecision.description: Decimal places of the tolerance on the dual(secondary) value, 0 to 8. Applies to every tolerance type that prints a value. Out of range is refused. The Styles panel offers 0 to 6, but an imported drawing can carry up to 8. Refused on angular dimensions, which have no dual value.

isDualPrecisionOverridden.description: True if the dimension sets its own dual(secondary) tolerance precision. False makes it follow the drawing's default value. Send true to keep a dualPrecision overridden even when it equals the drawing's default value, so it does not change when the drawing's default value changes.

upperValue.description: Upper value of tolerance, if tolerance type is Deviation / Symmetrical / Limits.

lowerValue.description: Lower value of tolerance, if tolerance type is Deviation / Limits.

fitType.description: Fit type/Fit with tolerance/Fit Tolerance only

precision.description: Tolerance precision(Fit with tolerance/fit tolerance only), 0 to 8 decimal places.

isPrecisionOverridden.description: True if the tolerance precision is overridden.

isStackedEnabled.description: True if stacked visibility is enabled for fit tolerance

fitToleranceStackedType.description: Stacked visibility type for fit tolerance
